title: Careen
summary: CAREEN, verb transitive In sea language, to heave or bring a ship to lie on one side, for the purpose of calking, repairing, cleansing, or paying over with pitch, the other side. CAREEN, verb intransi

inlines.v: CAREEN, verb transitive In sea language, to heave or bring a ship to lie on one side, for the purpose of calking, repairing, cleansing, or paying over with pitch, the other side. CAREEN, verb intransitive To incline to one side, as a ship under a press of sail.
